title: Golden T-Shirt 3D preview meshing
description: Panel meshing for the arrangement preview of the Golden T-Shirt 3D fixture: flat panel meshes in panel-local millimetres whose boundary follows the pinned pattern contour.
notes: Provisional. maxPlanarDeviationMm repeats the proposed 0.10 mm of the tolerance profile d2p:golden-tshirt-3d 1.0.0; the sampling and triangulation values are proposals for a preview-quality mesh. The profile MUST be frozen by maintainer decision before any implementation is compared against it.
